facts.text: Drop Dead Ned offers to hire himself and his killer wasp to the party for 100 gold for the week, doing anything as long as he gets to kill people with the wasp; he would give back 5 gold for each killing he is allowed, provided he can do what he wants with the victims.

classification.support_basis: Play establishes no specific want or debt that hiring Ned would advance; he only offers general services built around killing people.
classification.action_basis: Ned actually offered these terms and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it, but no established want is linked to the hire, so the advantage would be invented.
classification.opening_basis: Trigger: paying Ned 100 gold for the week. Benefit: a hired killer with a killer wasp, but no specific advantage toward any established want or debt is established.
